text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty detected delivery delays for alerts targeting the oncall rotation 'infra-oncall'. Some notifications failing 50-70% across sms/push since 13:30 UTC — https://status.pagerduty.com/ (PD incident: #PD-4532) :warning:

alex (on-call): I did not get the page for the spike on inference-api error-rate. saw the webhook retry logs only. Notified via slack now.

sasha: confirming — our PD integration webhook shows lots of 5xx from PD API at 13:29-13:36. PagerDuty status page shows "Degraded Performance" for API.

ravi: can someone confirm whether auto-ack/dedup rules are still working? i'm worried we have alerts queuing but not being delivered.

kevin: PD webhook retries are happening but PD's outbound delivery to push/SMS is where it's failing. we see `notification_status: delayed` in our delivery receipts.

maria (support): we're starting to get support tickets saying on-call didn't receive pages. Customer-impact check: customers may have delayed failover during 13:30-13:40 UTC. not widespread yet, a handful of enterprise customers reported degraded latency in their agent flows.

alex (on-call): okay, immediate mitigation: switch critical routing to phone-call fallback and email fallback. i'll also call the primary oncall directly.

sasha: i've run the fallback script to enable phone fallback for infra-oncall. command used:```bash
./scripts/pd-fallback-enable --rotation infra-oncall --method phone,email
```

ravi: good. i'm also adding a temporary alert-suppression for non-critical alerts to reduce noise while PD resolves. doing `pd-cli incidents suppress --policy non-critical`

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty API response: 503 Service Unavailable. Error ID: e2f3a9. Automatic retries in 30s.

kevin: paging backlog: approx 120 alerts in PD retry queue. i'm iterating through the list and escalating the top 10 by severity manually via phone.

maria (support): flagged impacted customers: cust-omega, cust-sierra. support on-call pinged them to confirm no critical data loss, only delayed incident response. customers ok for now but want a postmortem.

alex (on-call): phone escalation worked for a couple pages. still, we need a longer-term fallback — suggest enabling our Twilio relay for SMS + voice and flip to email for everything above Sev2.

sasha: Twilio relay is gated but runnable. i'm prepping the change:```yaml
alert_router:
  primary: pagerduty
  secondary: twilio_relay
  failover_on: delivery_failed
```
apply in ~2m after notifying PD status update.

ravi: PD status shows partial restoration at 13:44 UTC. but historical delays observed for next 20m. suggest we keep fallbacks enabled until 14:10 UTC and monitor token delivery.

kevin: i've opened a support case with PD (case PD-4532) and requested timeline + ack guarantees. also asked for export of missed delivery receipts.

maria (support): i'll prepare a customer-facing note for the two affected customers summarizing mitigation and expected ETA for full PD restore. also creating a support incident in zendesk and linking to this thread.

alex (on-call): incident declared Sev2. owner: alex. primary impact: delayed alert delivery to oncall (SMS/push). customer impact: delayed response for limited set of enterprise customers; application degraded for some agent flows but no data loss. timeline: started 13:30 UTC, mitigations in place by 13:39 UTC.

sasha: actions before postmortem: 1) write runbook for PD-delivery-fallback (owner: sasha) 2) build automated twilio fallback (owner: kevin) 3) evaluate dedup window/ retry policy with PD (owner: ravi) 4) customer comms (owner: maria).

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty update: "Service degradation mitigated, monitoring" at 13:47 UTC.

alex (on-call): good — keep fallbacks enabled for 20m then we can start scaling back. please add any missing info to the incident timeline. i'll own the postmortem and assign a P0 doc.

maria (support): note for postmortem: include exact list of customers impacted, support contact logs, and timeline of PD communications.

kevin: follow-up: we should consider a secondary alerting provider for critical pages (multi-provider fanout). i'll draft a proposal.

ravi: logging snippet for ops team in case of future PD 5xx:```json
{
  "event": "pd_notification_fail",
  "status": 503,
  "error_id": "${error_id}",
  "retry_count": ${retries}
}
```

alex (on-call): thanks everyone. closing this thread once postmortem is posted. TL;DR: PagerDuty delivery delays caused missed pages -> phone/email/Twilio fallbacks enabled -> limited customer impact -> Sev2 incident declared -> postmortem owner: alex. :white_check_mark:
